business_summary: Shanghai Trendzone Holdings Group Co.,Ltd provides solutions for urban development and city operations in China and internationally. The company offers consulting; urban renewal; one-stop headquarters technology park construction; ecosystem planning; smart construction platform; green sustainable development; lifecycle management; and city information modeling platform integration. It also provides smart wellness and elderly care, such as smart living environment design and renovation services, which include smart home systems, barrier-free designs, and safety monitoring systems; health monitoring and management systems consisting of health monitoring devices and health management platforms; personalized care, such as customized living solutions and professional nursing services; and smart elderly care community development, including smart elderly care center, community activity organization, research and development innovation, and product sale and rental. In addition, the company offers real estate models for high-end residences, affordable housing, cultural and artistic real estate, commercial office real estate, sports-related real estate, luxury hotels and mixed-use developments, green buildings and senior living communities, smart exhibition centers, co-living communities and talent housing, modular interior space, educational real estate, medical facilities, and tourism real estate, as well as architectural planning, interior design, renovation, soft furnishings, furniture, and landscaping services for luxury villas. Further, it engages in stone processing and sales; architectural design, decoration, and construction; cabinet production and installation; curtain wall engineering; sale of building materials; technology development; building technology; IoT; investment management; technology promotion and application; business; and general instrument manufacturing. Shanghai Trendzone Holdings Group Co.,Ltd was founded in 1998 and is based in Shanghai, China.
